dialogFocusChecks.note: Each opened dialog (correction/amend and wrong-patient/void, at desktop and phone widths) was checked to move keyboard focus inside the visible [role=dialog]; all 4 passed.

limits: Automated rules find a subset of WCAG failures. This run covers the visit confirmation step, the correction (amend) and wrong-patient (void) dialogs and the Hindi workspace screens at desktop (1280x720) and phone (390x844) widths. It does not cover screen-reader, zoom/reflow, high-contrast or reduced-motion modes, and no independent human or accessibility-specialist review was done. The wcag22a (WCAG 2.2 level A) tag is not included in the shared scan tag list (tests/ui/support/fixtures.mjs), matching the existing UI setup.
